title: Wear menu in AndroidAPS is not fully shown on coverscreen of Samsung Z Flip series
symptom: In AAPS V3.2.0.4 and V3.3.0 beta-1, the Wear tab is not scrollable like other menus/tabs, causing the bottom of the menu to become inaccessible on the coverscreen of the Samsung Z Flip series and on the main phone screen in landscape mode.
cause: The behavior of the Wear tab is different to be able to fill the bottom of the screen with the preview of the active watch face regardless of the screen resolution.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit in PR3592 by olorinmaia, which was merged into dev.
evidence_quote: PR3592 by @olorinmaia has fixed this issue.
